registry_name: Jester Quotes — Expanded Trickster Source Registry

source.source_text_policy: Source names and annotations retained as supplied; suggested corrections are separate.

usage_policy.image_policy: image is null when no selected display image exists; licensed/public-domain image records include direct src and credit metadata. Copyrighted editorial use requires its own fair-use justification, not prior Wikimedia approval.
usage_policy.editorial_summaries: All new summaries are original editorial drafts; citations may establish identity or work but not endorse trickster classification.
usage_policy.sources: Each entry has compilation provenance. Additional source records are labeled independent_context_reference or existing_verified_profile_reference; neither automatically means the entire profile is verified.
